scientific_integrity: Analytical theorem and exact attainment/strict gap with numerical examples. Proof relies on the published full admissibility region, quantile monotonicity and a strict Cauchy-Schwarz maximization; the reproducibility checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Fixed identical Chen margins only. The generic IFGM parameter domain and Pearson-affinity method are pre-existing, not claimed original. The original 1984 paper was accessible only by abstract/metadata, leaving a priority risk for general envelope geometry. The 2026 Chen-specific printed maximizing-corner assertion is directly contradicted. Numerical estimates are quadrature, not rigorous interval enclosures. No external validation was performed.
title: Sharp Pearson envelope for the iterated-FGM Chen model and a nonoptimal published corner
